memo|2843453e76.memo: An external AI diagnostic tool was asked to receive the patient record and provide support. Testing found L1 (k=1) privacy unsafe but useful; L2 (k=3) privacy unsafe and not useful; and L3 (k=525) privacy safe but not useful. The specific conflict is that the privacy-preserving release loses the relevant diagnosis: the full note’s top diagnosis is acute appendicitis, whereas the release reports heat stroke. Please choose either authorize L1 with safeguards and documented privacy risk, or reject external release and retain the record for clinician-only assessment.

memo|34d53f566c.memo: Requested: release this record to an external AI diagnostic tool. Testing found L1 (k=1) and L2 (k=3) privacy-failing but clinically useful. L3 (k=525) passed privacy but was not clinically useful. The conflict is that privacy protection changes the top diagnosis from acute appendicitis to heat stroke, while useful drafts fail privacy; no release may occur pending decision [GW-HITL-02]. Option 1: withhold the record and seek a safer clinically useful draft or review. Option 2: the DPO may authorize a failed draft only with documented legal basis, written reasons, audit flag, and governance review [GW-HITL-04].

memo|d4a83b34cd.memo: Requested was transmission of this record to an external AI diagnostic tool. Testing found L1 (k=1) privacy-failed but utility-passed; L2 (k=3) failed both; and L3 (k=525) passed privacy but failed utility. The conflict is that the useful draft identifies acute appendicitis, whereas the privacy-safe release changes the top diagnosis to heat stroke. Under [GW-HITL-02], choose: (1) retain the L3 privacy-safe draft, accepting limited utility; or (2) seek a lawful, documented DPO-approved release of a useful draft with consent or another legal basis, preserving Article 16 permit and the notice duties [GW-HITL-04] [LAW-PDPPL-04-19].

memo|89fd93d501.memo: Requested: release the patient record to an external AI diagnostic tool for clinical assistance. Testing found L1 (k=1) useful but privacy-failing; L2 (k=3) failed both privacy and utility; L3 (k=525) passed privacy but was useless; custom (k=98) passed privacy but was also useless. The privacy-safe drafts changed the diagnosis from acute appendicitis to heat stroke, creating a safety and utility conflict [GW-HITL-02]. Option one: withhold release pending safer, useful clinician-approved revision. Option two: seek consent or legal basis and DPO-recorded override, preserving permit, notice, audit requirements [GW-HITL-04].
